title: transcribe.cpp: Run 16+ Speech-to-Text Models Locally on Your Machine
description:
transcribe.cpp is a C/C++ library that runs speech-to-text models locally on your own hardware. Supports Whisper, Parakeet, Canary, and 13 more model families with GPU or CPU acceleration.
